# Upgrading Odoo modules on startup (2025-09-26 08:23Z)

_**User (2025-09-26 08:24Z)**_

also want to upgrade the following module 
om_odoo_inheritance during odoo start up
entrypoint: /usr/bin/python3 -m debugpy --listen 0.0.0.0:8888 /usr/bin/odoo -c /etc/odoo/odoo.conf -d odoo -i base -u om_hospital

---

_**Assistant (copilot/claude-sonnet-4)**_

To upgrade both the `om_hospital` and `om_odoo_inheritance` modules during Odoo startup, you need to add the second module to the `-u` parameter with a comma separator:

````yaml
// ...existing code...
entrypoint: /usr/bin/python3 -m debugpy --listen 0.0.0.0:8888 /usr/bin/odoo -c /etc/odoo/odoo.conf -d odoo -i base -u om_hospital,om_odoo_inheritance
// ...existing code...
````

The `-u` parameter accepts a comma-separated list of modules to upgrade during startup.
